questions.prompt: How many total individual grains of sand are contained within all standard children's plastic sandpits installed in residential backyards across Australia?
reasoning: Estimate Australia has about 1 million residential backyards with small children's sandpits.
Assume each sandpit holds roughly 100 litres of sand, equivalent to 0.1 cubic metres.
One cubic metre of dry sand contains roughly 120 million individual grains.
1,000,000 sandpits multiplied by 0.1 cubic metres times 120 million grains equals 12 trillion grains.

questions.prompt: How many total kilograms of raw white button mushrooms are harvested across all commercial indoor mushroom farms in the United Kingdom in a single year?
reasoning: The population of the United Kingdom is roughly 67 million people.
Estimate average annual per capita mushroom consumption is about 1.6 kilograms.
Total domestic consumption and production equate to roughly 110 million kilograms per year.

questions.prompt: How many total individual pages are contained within all bound hardback novels published by major publishing houses in the United States in a single year?
reasoning: Major U.S. publishers release roughly 30,000 new hardback novel titles annually.
Assume an average print run of 15,000 copies per title, yielding 450 million individual books printed.
Assume an average hardback novel contains 300 pages.
450 million books multiplied by 300 pages equals 135 billion pages printed across all copies.
